items.name: Golden Seed
items.effect: Increases Sacred Flask's number of uses
items.summary: Golden Seed is a bolstering material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
A golden seed, found at the base of an illusory tree.

Increases a Sacred Flask's number of uses. (Can be used after resting at a site of grace.)

items.name: Scadutree Fragment
items.effect: Reduces the damage taken by the Tarnished and increases the damage dealt by the Tarnished
items.summary:
Scadutree Fragment is a bolstering material in Elden Ring.

Its effect is only active while you are within the Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree DLC area, the Land of Shadow.

It reduces all incoming damage to the player, while also increasing all damage dealt. When you have collected all of them, the damage increase is equal to 200.5% and the damage decrease is equal to 51.3%.
items.description: A splinter of the Scadutree that contains golden brilliance. Acquired at the Church of Marika and other places in the realm of shadow. Consume these at sites of grace to bolster your Scadutree Blessing. The Scadutree Blessing bolsters the bearer's ability to deal and negate damage but has no influence outside the realm of shadow. It is said that when the Scadutree crumbles from its core that it will scatter across the entire realm of shadow. The people of the Erdtree collect the splinters and use them in prayer.

items.name: Revered Spirit Ash
items.effect: Reduces the damage taken by Torrent and Spirit Ashes and increases the damage dealt by Spirit Ashes
items.summary:
Revered Spirit Ash is a bolstering material in Shadow of the Erdtree.

Its effect is only active while you are within the Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree DLC area, the Land of Shadow.
items.description: Spirit ash of those who came before, infused with potent spirituality. Acquired from the corpses of hornsent and other objects that ritually decorate townships and villages across the realm of shadow. Consume these at sites of grace to bolster your Revered Spirit Ash Blessing. The Revered Spirit Ash Blessing bolsters both summoned spirits' and spectral steed's abilities to deal and negate damage but has no influence outside the realm of shadow. The withered corpses were called tutelary deities, and Revered Spirit Ash was said to quietly accumulate in the palms of their hands.
effect_details: Revered Spirit Ashes reduces the damage that Torrent takes while you ride it, reduces the damage taken by Ashes and increases their damage output. When you have collected all of them, the damage increase is equal to 75% and the damage decrease is equal to 62.5%.

→→ One is found on an altar just before the circling stairs leading to the Stagefront Site of Grace.
→→ One is found after defeating the Divine Beast Dancing Lion, by heading east and taking an elevator up to a corridor with an altar holding the Revered Spirit Ash.

items.name: Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
items.summary: Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone is a bolstering material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Smithing stone made by polishing a golden Gravel Stone. A scale of the Ancient Dragonlord, and hidden treasure of Farum Azula.

Strengthens armaments up to +25.

The Ancient Dragonlord's seat is said to lie beyond time. This stone lightly twists time, allowing the creation of a weapon capable of slaying a god.

details: There is a limited number of Ancient Dragon Smithing Stones that can be acquired each playthrough. There's 13 in the base game and 9 in the Realm of Shadow, for a total of 22 per playthrough. However keep in mind, some are obtained through quests, and can be locked out from obtaining them.
13x found in the base game:
1x given by Nepheli Loux at the end of her questline.
1x can be purchased from Gostoc at the end of Nepheli's questline for 20000 runes.
1x given by Witch-Hunter Jerren for siding with him against Sellen at the end of her questline.
1x from Gurranq as a reward for finding all 9 Deathroot.
→ Also drops from Gurranq if he's killed at the Bestial Sanctum. Doesn't drop if it has already been given in exchange for Deathroots.
1x from a corpse inside the mouth of a giant skeleton, just south of the Church of Repose. A spiritspring nearby is needed to get it.
1x dropped by the Night's Cavalry duo miniboss guarding the caravan with the Flowing Curved Sword in the Consecrated Snowfield. They also drop the Night's Cavalry Set.
1x in the Yelough Anix Tunnel, on a corpse near the end of the level.
1x on a corpse by the icy waterfall behind Great Wyrm Theodorix
2x can be obtained from two separate Ancient Dragons in Crumbling Farum Azula.
1x can be looted from a corpse in Crumbling Farum Azula
1x from a chest in Miquella's Haligtree, after the fight with Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.
1x Near the Haligtree Town Plaza grace, by a small plaza with a Misbegotten Warrior praying at a statue.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [8]
items.summary: Somber Smithing Stone [8] is a bolstering material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Large polar smithing stone drained of color.

Strengthens special armaments to +8.

Special armaments with unique characteristics cannot be strengthened with colored smithing stones. Number of steps and amount strengthened differ from standard equipment.

items.name: Somber Smithing Stone [9]
items.summary: Somber Smithing Stone [9] is a bolstering material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Ancient smithing stone drained of color.

Strengthens special armaments to +9.

Special armaments with unique characteristics cannot be strengthened with colored smithing stones. Number of steps and amount strengthened differ from standard equipment.

details: BASEGAME:
Found on a corpse on the raised platform in Lake of Rot where there's a lesser Alabaster Lord.
Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found to the west of Farum Greatbridge in Dragonbarrow.
In Mountaintops of the Giants: Found on a corpse on the bridge above the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins site of grace.
In Crumbling Farum Azula - A total of 4

1. Found on a corpse under a tree by the cliffside south of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace. You can reach this area by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the building.
2. Found under a leaning pillar in the heavily-ruined section just before jumping towards the Dragon Temple.

3. Found in the southwest at the bottom level of the Dragon Temple accessed by turning around to face west from the Site of Grace and then jumping down the crumbled ledges below. From here, head into the central archway and then turn right to find a crypt with several sarcophagi. Go through the archway in the west to an outdoor area where you can find a corpse holding the stone between two pillars.

4. Found on a corpse on an upper level balcony in the northern section past the Dragon Temple. From the north end of the temple, navigate your way across the floating debris to a narrow path laden with dragon statues, at the end of which you will find a spiral staircase on the right side. Head up these stairs and continue west to a balcony with a sealed Imp Statue barrier and several fallen pillars. The corpse holding the stone can be found behind one of these pillars.

Found on a corpse in a circle of chairs south of Divine Tower of Caelid. From the Dragonbarrow West Site of Grace, travel east following the road until you find a spring (water) with two dragons. Once at the spring, turn north and follow the ramp down. This will lead you towards the Divine Tower, and at the bottom you will see the circle of chairs. Somber Smithing Stone +9 along with other smaller stones, is found here.
Found in Yelough Anix Tunnel in the room where an Onyx Lord appears to attack you.
Found on a corpse inside a small building in Miquella's Haligtree found south of the Haligtree Town Plaza Site of Grace.
In Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree: Found on a corpse inside a room at the northern end of the ring walkway in the east. Guarded by a Crystalian (non-boss).
In Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree: Found on a corpse inside a dark building guarded by 3 Crystalians (non-boss). This building is found in the lower levels of the area.
Consecrated Snowfield: Found on a corpse sitting on a chair, to the northeast of the Apostate Derelict.
Consecrated Snowfield: Can be looted on top of a rock formation North of the Hidden Path to the Haligtree.
Consecrated Snowfield: Found with an invisible Teardrop Scarab atop a rock formation west of the Minor Erdtree (Consecrated Snowfield)
SOTE:
Ancient Ruins of Rauh: On top of the branch from where the enemy is casting spells at you.
One is right next to the Site of Grace and directly next to where the Tarnished will spawn when they teleport into the location.
Shadow Keep: Take the lift to the Specimen Storehouse, and turn right as you exit it.

Ancient Ruins of Rauh: From Viaduct Minor Tower Site of Grace, take the lift down and follow the stairway down to bridge level. It will be in the room on your right. From West Rampart Site of Grace, go through the small door West and cross the bridge with the Giant Bats. It will be in the room past the Fire Knight.
Enir-Ilim: Once you arrive in Enir-Ilim, look behind you to find a body containing the Stone.
1.6% to drop from Horned Warriors.
1.6% chance to drop from Horned Shaman.

items.name: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
items.summary: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone is an bolstering material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Ancient dragonrock smithing stone drained of color. A scale of the Ancient Dragonlord, and hidden treasure of Farum Azula.

Strengthens special armaments to +10.

The Ancient Dragonlord's seat is said to lie beyond time. This stone lightly twists time, allowing the creation of a weapon capable of slaying a god.

details: There is a limited number of Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stones that can be acquired each playthrough. As of now, a total number of 8 have been discovered:
Three in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.
One from Latenna upon completing her questline.
One in the Mohgwyn Palace.
One in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.
One in the Crumbling Farum Azula.
One dropped by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater at the Consecrated Snowfield.
In Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree, slaying a Ghostflame Dragon will also provide a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone

items.name: Grave Glovewort [1]
items.summary: Grave Glovewort [1] is a bolstering material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits.

Strengthens ashes to +1.

The art of strengthening ashes is known as spirit tuning. Only a spirit tuner may perform this deed.

items.summary: Grave Glovewort [2] is a bolstering material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
White flower that blooms in catacombs. Each a soundless bell used to summon spirits.

Strengthens ashes to +2.

Spirit tuning is not merely the simple act of imbuing strength. It is an art that lies somewhere between tuning an instrument and conducting a conversation, leaving both parties enriched.

items.name: Great Grave Glovewort
items.summary: Great Grave Glovewort is a bolstering material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
White flower that blooms in catacombs. An especially large specimen.

Strengthens ashes to +10.

Since times of old, large gloveworts were used to comfort heroic spirits. Given in tribute to those who died the most glorious of deaths, in the hope their stories would become legend.

items.summary: Ghost Glovewort [1] is a bolstering material in Elden Ring.
items.description:
White flower that blooms in catacombs. A spirit nestles close to it.

Strengthens renowned ashes to +1.

Ashes which keep their renown even after death cannot be strengthened by merely corporeal glovewort.
